'''Shrimpyro''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Pyropawn]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Has a strong sense of justice but is easily misguided. An innocent gopher was once accused as the bad guy, and Shrimpyro charged in without a second thought. Punch first, think later. Plenty of heroic deeds, plenty of enemies to show for it."

Shrimpyro is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A red, shrimp-like creature with a white underbelly, blue eyes, and yellow-orange claws that resemble boxing gloves. It also has a yellow triangle marking on its forehead.

Shrimpyo's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with magenta, orange with pink, and yellow becomes peach.

== Evolution Trial ==
Shrimpyro's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Pyroprawn]] you need to complete the following task:
* Obtain 800 Energy Drinks via pinball.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Shrimpyro has a favorite manga. It's called One-Punch Prawn! It's serialized."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Shrimpyro's claws resemble a pair of tiny boxing gloves that strike against any injustice. Though small im size, Shrimpyro still packs quite a punch."
